annotation.summary_en: Council Directive 93/68/EEC harmonises the CE marking across twelve New Approach product directives, including machinery, toys, medical devices and electrical equipment. It standardises the marking's form, notified-body notification, and procedures against improper CE marking. Relevant to robotics only indirectly, through the machinery directive.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces 'EC mark' with a uniform 'CE marking' across twelve directives
Presumption of conformity for CE-marked products and products complying with harmonised standards
Member States notify bodies; Commission publishes list with identification numbers
Misleading markings prohibited; improperly affixed CE marking must be corrected or product restricted or withdrawn
Transposition by 1 July 1994, application from 1 January 1995
